title: satureja calamintha var. glandulosa
intro: Satureja calamintha var. glandulosa, commonly known as Calamintha glandulosa, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Calamintha glandulosa include its use as an antispasmodic and expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
